messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — VectorFlow wants a hosted PoC burst Thurs 10:00-10:25 PT. Theyre running a synthetic runner (~120 clients ~10 rps). Org: org-vector-88. Can we get a scoped key + temporary token quota increase + IP allowlist?
Priya: What model and avg token size? Need to convert to tokens/min to set quota.
Jordan: Hitting /v1/generate model redwood-1.3-large. Avg ~360 tokens (prompt+resp). Estimate: 120 * 10 * 360 = 432k tokens/min. Asking for 550k/min to be safe.
Samir: Thats ~7.2k tokens/sec. us-west-2 pool can handle this if we reserve. Recommend token_quota_per_minute=550000, concurrent_request_limit=180, valid_window=2026-09-02T17:00:00Z/2026-09-02T17:25:00Z (25m window). Also suggest routing_policy fallback to redwood-1.3-small to avoid hard 429s.
Olivia: Security checklist: scoped key only, IP allowlist required, redact prompts in logs, retention 72h, no external audit export for this key. Need named contact for any data requests.
Jordan: Contact is ops@vectorflow.ai. Ill DM IP ranges in a bit. Also want a header indicating fallback so app metrics can tag responses.
Samir: We'll set routing_policy.response_header=X-RW-ServedModel. Example admin create Ill run after IPs: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"org_id":"org-vector-88","name":"vectorflow-poc-burst","scopes":["gen:invoke"],"token_quota_per_minute":"550000","concurrent_request_limit":"180","valid_window":"2026-09-02T17:00:00Z/2026-09-02T17:25:00Z","routing_policy":{"fallback_model":"redwood-1.3-small","response_header":"X-RW-ServedModel"}}'
```
infra-bot: ACTION: reserved extra capacity on pool us-west-2 for tag "vectorflow-poc-burst"  ticket INF-6021  reserved 600 rps-equivalent.
Priya: Please ensure logs mask fields: prompt_text, user_email and retention set to 72h. Also require IP allowlist before key issue.
Samir: Noted. Well attach an observability alert: page on 5xx > 1% for 5m OR median latency > 450ms, and auto-throttle the key if cross-customer impact detected.
Jordan: IPs DMd. Can you confirm when key is ready and share secure delivery?
Samir: Scoped key created: sk_vector_poc_8821. Token quota=550000/min, concurrent cap=180, retention=72h, fallback configured, header X-RW-ServedModel enabled. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/poc/vectorflow-8821.
Priya: Security sign-off complete. Exports disabled.
Jordan: Thanks team — Ill run the test and post results. Please monitor errors/latency and call out if >1% 5xx or median latency >450ms. :thumbsup:
